Action: Inventory all cloud regions, APIs, jobs, buckets, secrets, databases, domains, NAS services and external providers.
Definition_of_done: Every asset has an owner, environment, data classification and documented exposure; unexpected assets are investigated.

Action: Create a production environment isolated from development/staging identities, data, secrets, storage and billing integrations.
Definition_of_done: Development credentials, artificial players and simulator transactions cannot affect production; existing staging workflows remain usable.

Action: Enforce production startup/export guards disabling development login, artificial drivers, purchase simulation and debug trust material.
Definition_of_done: Release artifacts and deployed production settings pass negative tests for every development bypass.

Action: Put cloud access policies, service limits and security configuration under reviewed version control with drift detection.
Definition_of_done: A reviewed plan reproduces the intended configuration and an intentional drift change is detected without exposing secrets.

Action: Approve availability, endpoint latency, verification delay, capacity, alert-delivery and recovery targets; assign operational owners.
Definition_of_done: Numeric service targets, recovery point/time objectives, cost envelope and escalation coverage are recorded; provisional load budgets are reviewed.

Action: Audit use of the default Compute service account and remove or replace its project-wide Editor grant.
Definition_of_done: Required workloads and deployments still pass; the default account has only explicitly justified permissions or is disabled.

Action: Separate API, race worker and privileged administrative workload identities and secret access.
Definition_of_done: The race worker cannot read the administrator key or migration database credential; permission-denial tests verify each boundary.

Action: Enforce a keyless workload/deployment policy using attached identities or workload federation; restrict key creation/upload where available.
Definition_of_done: No unnecessary user-managed keys exist and an unauthorized key-creation or identity-impersonation attempt is denied.

Action: Protect Google Cloud, source control, Play Console, billing and administrator accounts with phishing-resistant MFA and recovery arrangements.
Definition_of_done: Owner demonstrates MFA, recovery access and access revocation without relying on one unavailable device.

Action: Replace routine project-Owner deployment access with scoped roles; review IAM and dormant identities regularly.
Definition_of_done: Normal release succeeds without Owner; a dated permission review covers users, groups, service accounts, impersonation, secrets and jobs.

Action: Place administrative routes behind a dedicated authenticated access boundary, such as a private admin service or identity-aware gateway.
Definition_of_done: Ordinary internet and game-token callers cannot bypass that boundary through the default Cloud Run URL.

Action: Activate named administrator/analyst identities with real end-to-end MFA and immediate revocation.
Definition_of_done: Test actual identity-provider MFA, role separation, session expiry and revocation; ordinary Google game login grants no staff authority.

Action: Retire legacy administrator bearer keys after the replacement access path is proven.
Definition_of_done: Old keys are rejected; the new named access and controlled emergency recovery path both work.

Action: Require appropriate roles, deliberate confirmation and recent authentication for grants, restrictions, publication interventions and sensitive changes.
Definition_of_done: Analyst and ordinary-user attempts fail; sensitive commands are retry-safe and record the named actor, reason and exact target.

Action: Protect privileged audit records from ordinary application modification and retain them independently.
Definition_of_done: A grant/revocation generates a tamper-resistant audit record and alert; access, retention and export are tested.

Action: Create an authorization matrix for every API method, object, field and role, including blocked, disabled and deleted accounts.
Definition_of_done: Automated tests cover anonymous, owner, other player, analyst and administrator behavior; no unchecked write or private-data route remains.

Action: Extend attack tests for token replay, refresh recovery, browser handoff, expired tickets, changed contracts and in-flight account revocation.
Definition_of_done: Tampered/replayed requests and cross-account substitutions are rejected while legitimate lost-response recovery remains possible.

Action: Validate client-address trust, rate limits, method handling, compressed-body limits and slow-upload isolation through the real cloud ingress.
Definition_of_done: Spoofed forwarding headers do not evade limits; malformed/slow traffic cannot consume all authenticated upload capacity.

Action: Validate release-client credential storage, TLS behavior, sign-out and account switching on physical Android devices.
Definition_of_done: Credentials remain protected by platform storage, are absent from logs/exports, and stale callbacks cannot attach to a different account.

Action: Audit SQL construction, file paths, subprocesses, outbound requests, CORS, browser policy and unsafe rendering.
Definition_of_done: Injection, traversal, SSRF, cross-origin privilege and unsafe deserialization probes fail across public and administrative surfaces.

Action: Approve the competitive trust policy: retain lightweight trajectories with explicit residual risk or authorize stronger verification for sensitive results.
Definition_of_done: Document what the system can prove, tolerated cheating exposure and which results require additional review; retain current policy until decided.

Action: Implement and adversarially test the chosen race-verification policy, including fabricated plausible paths and modified physics.
Definition_of_done: Evidence demonstrates the selected guarantee and limits. Play Integrity, if selected, is request-bound and treated as an additional signal.

Action: Hold suspicious exceptional records for review and detect implausible improvements, sector patterns and repeated identical evidence.
Definition_of_done: A suspicious result cannot silently become a trusted championship/world record; the normal race summary and legitimate progress remain available.

Action: Resolve the trust weakness in client-reported collision/off-track incidents used for clean-race Coins and achievements.
Definition_of_done: Fabricating an incident-free flag cannot silently mint rewards presented as independently verified; any retained tradeoff is explicit and monitored.

Action: Retain versioned evidence and provide audited result exclusion, standings correction and player appeal tools.
Definition_of_done: A seeded cheating case can be investigated and corrected reproducibly without silently rewriting historical evidence or unrelated results.

Action: Add privacy-reviewed detection for account clusters, automated race farming and coordinated account activity.
Definition_of_done: Known synthetic abuse patterns are surfaced for review; shared-IP households and carrier networks do not trigger automatic blanket bans.

Action: Stress-test popularity and ratings against many accounts, repeated races, replayed votes and artificial identities.
Definition_of_done: One player cannot inflate distinct-player metrics through repetition; coordinated real-account influence has review rules and recoverable corrections.

Action: Detect repeated low-skill placement and coordinated competitive manipulation.
Definition_of_done: Seeded sandbagging/collusion patterns are reviewable, while new players, returning players and genuine improvement remain eligible.

Action: Reconcile Coin and entitlement ledgers under concurrent rewards, purchases, grants, retries and account deletion.
Definition_of_done: Balances equal durable ledger entries; no duplicate rewards, double spending or deleted-account resurrection occurs on PostgreSQL.

Action: Define and enforce ownership rules for shared car appearance and paid/server-valued content.
Definition_of_done: Forged client ownership cannot grant server entitlements or unowned shared cosmetics; the limits of purely local cosmetic enforcement are documented.

Action: Complete release Play Billing integration with account-bound server purchase verification and the real approved product catalog.
Definition_of_done: A provider test purchase grants the correct account/product exactly once; wrong-account, pending and invalid purchases do not grant.

Action: Make purchase delivery, acknowledgement/consumption and completion recovery durable across app/server restarts and provider outages.
Definition_of_done: A grant followed by a lost completion response recovers without a duplicate grant or permanently stranded transaction.

Action: Implement authenticated real-time provider notifications, periodic reconciliation and refund/voided-purchase handling.
Definition_of_done: Duplicate, delayed, missing and out-of-order events converge to correct entitlements; consumed publishing slots have an approved non-destructive refund policy.

Action: Wire production signed AdMob SSV into durable account-bound, transaction-deduplicated reward fulfillment.
Definition_of_done: Forged/replayed callbacks never grant; authentic delayed callbacks, provider key changes and retries grant at most once; release consent/configuration is tested.

Action: Run provider-sandbox acceptance for pending/cancelled/refunded purchases, reinstall, account/device switching and delayed ad callbacks.
Definition_of_done: Saved receipts show correct balances, slots, resumes and ad-free expiry for the complete failure/recovery matrix.

Action: Fuzz JSON decoding, track schemas, geometry compilation and native kernels with malformed and adversarial documents.
Definition_of_done: Crashes, unbounded allocation, hangs and unsafe inputs are rejected safely; discovered failures become retained regressions.

Action: Benchmark maximum legal track complexity on target phones and the deployed verifier limits.
Definition_of_done: Worst-case accepted tracks stay inside approved load-time, CPU, GPU, memory and thermal budgets, or receive explicit complexity rejection.

Action: Prove worker isolation, execution timeouts, cancellation, storage quotas and rejected-evidence cleanup under hostile inputs.
Definition_of_done: A failing track cannot exhaust unrelated work, execute supplied code or accumulate unbounded retained evidence.

Action: Exercise client cancellation, backgrounding, low-memory recovery and repeated editor/race transitions with large tracks.
Definition_of_done: No unbounded caches, orphan work, resource leaks or permanent inability to reopen a legitimate saved track.

Action: Test hostile track/player/challenge text across Studio, profiles, sharing, exports, logs and moderation surfaces.
Definition_of_done: Markup, scripts, CSV formulas, path fragments and control characters cannot execute, escape their output context or expose secrets.

Action: Choose a cloud-edge abuse protection design and verify the protected entry point cannot be bypassed.
Definition_of_done: Selected edge controls, trusted proxy settings and direct Cloud Run access are consistent and tested under distributed abuse.

Action: Approve actual spending thresholds, alert recipients and any supported Cloud Run-specific spend cap.
Definition_of_done: Test notification delivery and document exactly which costs remain uncapped and what service interruption a cap causes.

Action: Review effective compute, storage, egress, logging, database and per-account/global application quotas.
Definition_of_done: Document attainable cost exposure and capacity limits; ordinary traffic fits while hostile traffic reaches bounded rejection.

Action: Run bounded open-arrival abuse/load tests mixing anonymous reads, authentication, uploads and legitimate racing.
Definition_of_done: Measure p95/p99 latency, billed-work proxies, queue age, memory and recovery; legitimate-player impact meets the approved targets.

Action: Prepare and rehearse reversible incident controls for expensive endpoints, publication work and abusive accounts.
Definition_of_done: An operator can contain cost growth and restore service without deleting player data or creating a routine paid/limited-racing gate.

Action: Enforce encrypted direct database connections and retain narrow network/IAM access; review private connectivity against cost and threat model.
Definition_of_done: Plaintext direct connections fail; Cloud SQL connector, migrations, workers and tested recovery continue working.

Action: Configure recovery retention and point-in-time recovery consistent with approved data-loss objectives; protect backup administration.
Definition_of_done: Recorded settings meet the recovery point objective and a compromised ordinary runtime cannot remove every recovery copy.

Action: Restore representative database and object data into an isolated environment, then reapply the independent erasure journal.
Definition_of_done: Restore completes within the approved time; accounts, purchases, records and links are consistent and deleted identities remain deleted.

Action: Exercise schema migrations, interrupted rollout and rollback/forward-recovery with historical tracks, receipts and records.
Definition_of_done: Recovery preserves compatible historical contracts and immutable data; no rollback requires discarding legitimate progress.

Action: Inspect NAS/router exposure and isolate public game workloads from DSM management, Docker control and unrelated private files.
Definition_of_done: External exposure checks show intended endpoints only; a game-container compromise cannot reach NAS administration or unrelated shares.

Action: Activate independent uptime and dependency checks with real delivery to the operational owner.
Definition_of_done: Stopping a disposable test API produces an externally delivered alert and recovery notification inside the approved detection target.

Action: Add operational dashboards and actionable alerts for request failures/latency, verifier health, queue age, DB disk/pool, object growth and spend.
Definition_of_done: Seeded failures and the fixed database-disk threshold trigger alerts before resource exhaustion; each alert links to a runbook.

Action: Add security alerts for privilege/public-access changes, key creation, unusual secret reads, auth abuse, grants and reward/record anomalies.
Definition_of_done: Harmless test events reach the correct receiver, with tuning for false positives and attributable actor/target evidence.

Action: Enable selected Data Access audit logs and protect/redact log stores with explicit access, retention and cost limits.
Definition_of_done: Required investigations have evidence; tokens/provider payloads stay absent and unauthorised users cannot read or modify audit records.

Action: Monitor the watchdog, log collector and notification service themselves; define acknowledgement and backup escalation.
Definition_of_done: A stopped collector, stale data feed, failed receiver and restart are detected without silently losing or duplicating incidents.

Action: Enable a reviewed vulnerability/advisory scanning workflow for container OS, Python, Godot, native libraries and Android SDKs.
Definition_of_done: The actual release digest and dependency inventory are scanned; findings have patch deadlines and documented exceptions.

Action: Produce release component inventories and provenance, verify upstream hashes and promote the exact tested immutable image/artifacts.
Definition_of_done: A released server/client can be traced to reviewed source, dependency versions, build inputs and acceptance receipts.

Action: Protect branches, release environments, CI tokens and deployment permissions; review external build actions and fork behavior.
Definition_of_done: Untrusted changes cannot access release secrets or deploy; normal reviewed releases use scoped temporary credentials.

Action: Scan Git history, build artifacts, Android packages and logs for secrets; test rotation and revocation of confirmed exposures.
Definition_of_done: Actual exposure is removed and revoked without printing secret contents; no release artifact contains development credentials or private signing material.

Action: Rehearse backup, canary, health verification, promotion and safe rollback/forward recovery with matching client/API/worker contracts.
Definition_of_done: An intentionally bad release is caught or recovered while preserving accounts, saved intents, records, tracks and entitlements.

Action: Assign moderation coverage, severity handling, response targets and appeal ownership.
Definition_of_done: A staged report/block/appeal case reaches an owner and is resolved with an audit trail; reports alone do not automatically punish a player.

Action: Replace privacy/contact placeholders and align actual retention, provider disclosures, production ad consent and Play Data Safety/account-deletion declarations.
Definition_of_done: Published app/web policies, release SDK behavior, provider configuration and store declarations agree after appropriate review.

Action: Validate native/web account deletion, consent, offline retries and account switching with real staging identities.
Definition_of_done: Deleted accounts cannot reauthenticate; private erasure progresses, shared history is retained as designed, and restore cannot resurrect identities.

Action: Write incident runbooks for stolen credentials, data exposure, cheating, payment fraud, outages and cost attacks.
Definition_of_done: A tabletop exercise identifies the decision maker, containment steps, evidence handling, player communication and safe restoration.

Action: Publish security/support contact routes and a responsible vulnerability-reporting process.
Definition_of_done: An external report receives an acknowledgement, triage owner, tracking identity and fix/retest follow-up without public player-data disclosure.

Action: Run the skipped PostgreSQL concurrency cases plus the full relevant auth, economy, publication, privacy and native regression suites.
Definition_of_done: The chosen release has explicit pass/fail/skip receipts; required concurrency guarantees have real PostgreSQL evidence.

Action: Test signed release clients on representative Android devices against the production-equivalent staging stack.
Definition_of_done: Real sign-in, five-lap race, retry, publish, ghost, account switching, purchase/ad sandbox and deletion workflows pass applicable release gates.

Action: Run sustained capacity and fault tests for process death, dependency/provider outage, network loss, full disk and queue recovery.
Definition_of_done: No duplicate/lost grants or accepted invalid results; queues recover and measured availability, latency, memory and recovery meet approved targets.

Action: Commission an independent scoped penetration and abuse review of the release candidate and cloud configuration.
Definition_of_done: Critical/high findings are resolved and retested or have explicit owner-approved treatment and compensating controls.

Action: Maintain a release sign-off checklist with owners, evidence links, accepted risks and recurring IAM/patch/restore/alert reviews.
Definition_of_done: Every release gate is evidenced or explicitly deferred for a limited launch; recurring checks have owners and due dates.
